SELECT round(100 * sumIf(delta, Attributes['status'] = '5xx') / greatest(sum(delta), 1), 2) AS rate FROM (SELECT Attributes, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY Attributes)

SELECT round(100 * sumIf(delta, Attributes['status'] = '4xx') / greatest(sum(delta), 1), 2) AS rate FROM (SELECT Attributes, max(Value) - min(Value) AS delta FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY Attributes)

tiles.name: Requests per second by status class

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['status'] AS status, round((max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s, 2) AS rps FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY ts, status ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['method'] AS method, round((max(Value) - min(Value)) / $__interval_s, 2) AS rps FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY ts, method ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['method'] AS method, round(1000 * sum(Sum) / greatest(sum(Count), 1), 1) AS mean_ms FROM $__sourceTable(histogram) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_request_duration_seconds' GROUP BY ts, method ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['status'] AS status, max(Value) - min(Value) AS requests FROM $__sourceTable(sum) WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'http_requests' GROUP BY ts, status ORDER BY ts

SELECT SpanName AS probe, StatusCode AS status, count() AS checks, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1e6), 1) AS p95_ms, max(Timestamp) AS last_seen FROM $__sourceTable WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND $__filters AND (SpanName ILIKE '%health%' OR SpanName ILIKE '%readiness%' OR SpanName ILIKE '%liveness%') GROUP BY probe, status ORDER BY checks DESC
